expectations: A memory states that the payments queue is in the Gold tier and that its jobs wait at most 30 seconds.

items.memory: Every Kestrel queue belongs to one tier, and the tier sets how long a job may wait before a worker picks it up.
The Kestrel payments queue is in the Gold tier, with a maximum wait of 30 seconds before a worker picks it up.
The Kestrel invoices queue is in the Gold tier, with a maximum wait of 2 minutes before a worker picks it up.
The Kestrel reports queue is in the Bronze tier, with a maximum wait of 1 hour before a worker picks it up.
A Kestrel queue whose wait exceeds its tier's maximum pages the on-call engineer.
